notInPlan.title: Not part of your society's plan
notInPlan.chat: Community chat is not included for your building. Official notices are still available.

groupAbout.site: Everyone who lives here, and the society office
groupAbout.custom: A group set up by the society office

chat.title: Community chat
chat.introResident: Talk with neighbours in the groups you belong to. Groups follow where you live.
chat.introOffice: Your groups: the whole community and the office team. Block and floor groups are for residents.
chat.simulated: Demo: messages are fictional and stay in this browser. Nothing is sent to real people.
chat.chooseGroup: Choose a group to read its messages.
chat.noGroupsBody: Groups come from where you live: when you move in, you join your building and floor automatically.
chat.notOpenResident: Your society has not yet set how long messages are kept. Chat opens once it does.
chat.notOpenOffice: Set how long messages are kept (Groups and moderation → Policy) to open chat.
chat.noDirect: Private messages between residents are off in this community.
chat.rejoinFailed: Could not join the group again
chat.visibleFrom: You see messages from {{date}}, when you joined this group.
chat.noMessages: No messages yet. Start the conversation.
chat.notMemberTitle: You are not in this group
chat.notMemberBody: This group's messages are not available to you. If you moved out, your groups ended on that day.

message.removed: This message was removed by a moderator.
message.removedMine: Your message was removed by a moderator.

composer.label: Write a message
composer.hint: Everyone in this group can read it. Ctrl+Enter sends.
composer.readOnly: Only the society office posts in this group. You can read it.

offline.off: Demo: you can simulate losing the connection to see what happens to messages written offline.
offline.on_one: Offline (simulated). {{count}} message is waiting on this device; it is checked again when you reconnect.
offline.on_other: Offline (simulated). {{count}} messages are waiting on this device; they are checked again when you reconnect.
offline.copy: Offline: showing the messages loaded at {{time}}. They are checked again when you reconnect.
offline.notLoaded: Offline: this group was not loaded before you went offline.
offline.rejectedBody: You are no longer in the group (for example, after a move-out). The group's messages were removed from this device.

report.title: Report this message
report.subtitle: A moderator from the society office will review it.
report.noteRequired: Tell the moderator what is wrong
report.privacy: The person who wrote it is not told who reported it. Moderators see only reported messages.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.effect: You will not see their messages in any group. They are not told, and you can unblock them under About this group.

about.title: About {{name}}
about.automatic: Members are added and removed automatically from the society's records; nobody is added by hand.
about.retention_one: Messages are shown for {{count}} day, then removed from the chat. A reported message may be kept longer as evidence for the moderators only; it is never shown in the chat again.
about.retention_other: Messages are shown for {{count}} days, then removed from the chat. A reported message may be kept longer as evidence for the moderators only; it is never shown in the chat again.
about.muteHint: Unread messages are still counted here but not added to your Community home.
about.leaveEffect: You will stop seeing its messages. If you join again later, you will not see what was written while you were away.
about.notices: Official announcements are published as notices, not in chat.

home.title: Community
home.intro: Notices from the office and what {{site}} shares.
home.issues: Report something broken in a common area
home.noticesOneWay: Notices are one-way announcements from the office.
home.simulated: Demo: the community, its people and providers are fictional.

poll.informal: Informal poll: it is not a formal vote under the society's bylaws and does not decide anything on its own.
poll.none: No polls for you right now
poll.noneBody: When the office asks your building something, it appears here.
poll.named: Named: the office sees your answer.
poll.anonymousLong: Anonymous: your answer is counted, but nobody, including the office, can see what you chose.
poll.namedLong: Named poll: the society office will see your name, your flat and your answer once the poll closes. Other residents never see who answered.
poll.closedWaiting: Closed. The office has not published the results yet.
poll.privacyRule: Results are shown only for groups large enough that no household's answer can be worked out.

hidden.below_threshold: Not enough responses to show results. This protects the privacy of the few who answered.
hidden.audience_too_small: The audience is too small to show results without revealing how households answered.

poll.withheld: Results withheld for privacy: the answers per option are not shown because they could reveal how one or two people answered.
poll.namedConsent: I understand that the office will see my name and my answer.

services.disclaimer: The society lists providers it has checked, but does not guarantee their work. Agree prices and terms with the provider directly.
services.noneBody: Try another category or search, or ask the office to suggest one.
services.noPhone: Contact details are not shared. Ask the society office.
services.reportHint: At least 10 characters. The office reviews every report; the provider is not told who reported.
services.reportSent: Thank you. The office will review it.

resources.none: No documents published for you yet.
resources.demoFile: Demo document, fictional data. The real file is not stored in this prototype.
resources.officeIntro: Documents the society publishes to residents: bylaws, forms, guides and minutes.
resources.gateNote: This release covers publishing to residents. The full document centre (versions, expiry, templates) comes in a later gate.
resources.fileHint: Demo: only the file's name and size are kept in this browser.
resources.withdrawEffect: Residents will no longer see it. The record stays here with your reason.

audience.hint: People are taken from verified records on the day; nobody is added by hand.

office.title: Chat groups and moderation
office.intro: Automatic groups, custom groups, reported messages and the retention policy.
office.simulated: Demo: chat is simulated and does not deliver messages to real people.
office.smartIntro: Smart groups follow the society's records: who lives where today, committee terms and staff roles. Switch a group off, or let only the office post in it.
office.customIntro: A custom group follows an audience you choose (for example, Block A owners). Residents may leave it.
office.staffAlwaysOn: The office team's own group is always on.
office.previewAsOf_one: {{count}} member today, from the society's records
office.previewAsOf_other: {{count}} members today, from the society's records
office.previewEmpty: Nobody is in this group today.
office.previewPrivacy: Names are shown to the office only, to check the rule. Residents never see a group's member list.
office.noCustomBody: Create one for a part of the community, such as the owners of one block.
office.reportsIntro: Moderators see only the reported message, never the rest of a conversation. Reporters are never named.
office.decisionNote: Note for the record (at least 5 characters)

hide.title: Remove this message?
hide.effect: Everyone in the group will see that a moderator removed a message, without its text. The author is told in the app.

warn.title: Warn the author?
warn.effect: The message stays. The author is reminded of the group rules in the app; they are not told who reported it.

dismiss.title: Dismiss this report?
dismiss.effect: Nothing changes in the group. The report is kept with your note.

office.noticesIndependent: Official notices work without chat or the community hub.
office.evidenceHold: Kept as evidence: past the retention period, so no longer shown in the chat. Moderators see it only while this report is open.
office.textGone: Message text no longer kept: the retention period has ended and the report is decided.

policy.title: Message retention
policy.notSet: Not set: chat stays closed until the society sets a retention period.
policy.why: No legal period is assumed, and the demo's 365 days is not a recommendation: check what applies to your society before production. When the period ends, a message leaves every chat; a reported message is kept as evidence for the moderators until the report is decided.
policy.held_one: {{count}} reported message is past the period and kept as evidence for the moderators only (not shown in any chat).
policy.held_other: {{count}} reported messages are past the period and kept as evidence for the moderators only (not shown in any chat).
policy.etiquetteHint: Shown to every member under About this group.
policy.reviewed: Our society has checked the privacy and record-keeping rules that apply to it.
policy.readOnly: Only people who manage chat groups can change the policy.
policy.history: New members do not see messages written before they joined.
policy.revocation: When someone moves out, their groups end at once; messages they wrote offline are refused when they reconnect.

directory.title: Local services
directory.intro: Providers residents can call, vetted by the office. Residents recommend and report; nothing is paid through the app.
directory.rules: Contact numbers are shown only with the provider's recorded consent. Someone other than the person who added a provider vets it.
directory.addedToast: {{name}} added; it waits for vetting by a colleague
directory.name: Provider name
directory.servesHint: For example: Al-Noor Residency and nearby blocks.
directory.noPhone: Not kept (no consent to show it)
directory.consentShow: {{method}} consent to list with the number, recorded by {{name}}
directory.consentHide: {{method}} consent to list without the number, recorded by {{name}}
directory.showContact: The provider agreed to show their contact number to residents
directory.consentHint: Without consent to show it, the number is not kept in the directory.
directory.vetOther: You added this provider, so a colleague vets it.

vet.title: List {{name}}?
vet.effect: Residents will see it in Local services, with the contact number only if the provider agreed.

reject.title: Reject {{name}}?
reject.effect: Residents never see it. The record stays with your reason.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.effect: Residents stop seeing it at once. Open reports about it are marked as acted on.

directory.dismissEffect: The provider stays listed. The report is kept with your note.

polls.title: Polls and surveys
polls.intro: Ask residents a question. Results are shared only after the poll closes, and only when enough people answered.
polls.draftNote: Saved as a draft. Residents see it only once you open it.
polls.namedHint: Named: after closing, the office sees who answered what. Residents never do.
polls.closesHint: Within 90 days. The poll closes at the end of that day.
polls.anonymousYes: Anonymous: nobody sees who answered what
polls.anonymousNo: Named: the office sees answers after closing
polls.noTally: No running tally: answers are counted when the poll closes.
polls.withdrawReason: Why (residents see this; at least 10 characters)

open.title: Open this poll?
open.effect_one: {{count}} eligible person or flat will be asked. The question and answers can no longer change.
open.effect_other: {{count}} eligible people or flats will be asked. The question and answers can no longer change.

close.title: Close the poll now?
close.effect_one: Nobody can answer after this. You will see the totals and can publish them.
close.effect_other: Nobody can answer after this. You will see the totals and can publish them.

publish.title: Publish the results?
publish.effect_one: Residents in the audience will see the results, within the privacy thresholds. Published results do not change.
publish.effect_other: Residents in the audience will see the results, within the privacy thresholds. Published results do not change.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this poll?
withdraw.effect_one: It stops at once and no results are shown. Residents see your reason.
withdraw.effect_other: It stops at once and no results are shown. Residents see your reason.

polls.totalsAnonymous: Answers per option (anonymous: as residents see them)
polls.totalsWithheld_one: Withheld for privacy: {{count}} answer, but the answers per option could reveal how one or two people answered. The office sees no more than residents in an anonymous poll.
polls.totalsWithheld_other: Withheld for privacy: {{count}} answers, but the answers per option could reveal how one or two people answered. The office sees no more than residents in an anonymous poll.

errors.retentionNotSet: Chat is not open: the society has not set how long messages are kept.
errors.postingRestricted: Only the society office posts in this group.
errors.ownMessage: You cannot report your own message.
errors.smartGroup: You are in this group because of where you live; it cannot be left.
errors.ownReport: You reported this message, so another moderator decides.
errors.ownMessageDecision: This is your own message, so another moderator decides.
errors.staffGroup: The office team's group cannot be switched off.
errors.nameTaken: A group with this name already exists.
errors.chooseRole: Choose at least one relationship to the flat.
errors.retentionRange: Enter a number of days from {{min}} to {{max}}.
errors.confirmReview: Confirm that the society checked the rules that apply to it.
errors.maxLength: Keep it to {{max}} characters or fewer.
errors.providerExists: A provider with this name is already in the directory.
errors.phone: Enter a phone number, for example +92 300 0000000.
errors.phoneForConsent: Enter the number the provider agreed to show.
errors.consentMethod: Record how the provider agreed to be listed.
errors.vetOwn: You added this provider, so a colleague vets it.
errors.stateChanged: This was changed in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
errors.twoOptions: Give at least two answers to choose from.
errors.closesInPast: The last day cannot be in the past.
errors.closesTooLate: Choose a last day within {{max}} days.
errors.onlyDraft: Only a draft can be edited.
errors.noAudience: Nobody is in this audience today.
errors.alreadyAnswered: Already answered (one answer per person or per flat).
errors.fileSize: The file must be {{max}} MB or smaller.
errors.namedConsent: This poll is named: confirm that you understand the office will see your name and answer.
